title: Build your own agents, Projects, Write and Meeting notes
highlights: 🛠 Agent Builder: make your own agent with a name, @handle, color, instructions, @features and voice. Share it with a 6-letter code.
📁 Projects: turn a Space into a project for a class or goal. Its goal, notes, files, decks and sources travel with every chat inside it.
⚑ Mission chains: Research → Outline → Draft. When a step finishes, the next one starts with the report handed over.
✎ Write mode: a document beside an agent that suggests edits you accept or skip one by one. Export to Word.
🎙 Meeting notes: record a class or call, watch the transcript build, then get a summary, decisions and action items for Reminders.
◷ Focus timer: Pomodoro blocks, an amber countdown orb, notifications held until your break, and points for every block.
📅 Calendar-aware study: give a deck a test date for a cram plan, plus study reminders in the free time between your events.
📷 N28C: scan your notes into a flashcard deck, follow missions live, and race friends in live study sessions with a leaderboard.
⚡ Faster: N28C updates instantly (realtime) and your Mac answers your phone quicker while it's open.
🌐 New pages: this What's new page, a hands-on demo, and an admin portal with an admin chat.

title: Nexus 2.0
highlights: A tidier bottom bar: Mission, Huddle, Debate, Watch, Routines and Study are one click away.
Routines got their own panel, and Settings are reorganized.
Sign up to be a beta tester right from Settings → Account.
N28C can start huddles, debates and citations, and switch routines on or off.
A new website with a landing page.

title: Your Mac's voice on your phone
highlights: N28C reads answers aloud in your Mac's voice (ElevenLabs, OpenAI or a macOS voice).
A compact composer and an orb that takes your agent's color.
The app icon refreshes after updates.

title: N28C for everyone
highlights: The phone app is out of beta: Settings → Phone.
Shared Spaces on the Mac, and Send to phone from any answer.
A new macOS 26 app icon that tints like the built-in apps.
Admins can unlock every orb skin.

title: N28C, the phone app
highlights: Notifications for answers, missions, routines and friends' posts, plus a study reminder and streak-saver.
Send to Mac, a clipboard bridge, missions from your phone and talk mode.
Homework photos, interactive answers, pinned chats, cram mode and Shared Spaces.
A new orb skin: Overlord.

title: School, fun and beta
highlights: Homework helper with hints first, and a citation helper (MLA, APA, Chicago).
Daily challenges, orb skins you unlock with points, and Nexus Wrapped.
A beta channel: testers get features and updates first.
The first version of the phone companion.

title: Routines, missions and study
highlights: Flashcard decks with spaced repetition and practice quizzes.
Mission templates and shareable mission reports (PDF / Word).
Evening Wrap-up and routines that run when an app opens.

title: Agents together
highlights: Huddles and debates between agents.
@features that do things: quizzes, flashcards, checklists, charts and more.
Themes and a theme editor.

title: Your Mac
highlights: Explain this: ask about selected text in any app.
Clipboard history and app actions.
Watch mode: get told when something happens in a window.

title: Hello, Nexus
highlights: Flash, Lyte, Neodela and Paragon in your menu bar.
Voice with Quick Ask, connectors, routines, Morning Brief and missions.
A free Nexus key so anyone can start chatting.
